description: A four-panel TEM figure of the Fe–10Mn–10Al–0.7C low-density steel annealed at 700 °C for 1 h, mixing bright-field and dark-field micrographs with an indexed selected-area diffraction pattern; the group is therefore composite (three micrographs + one diffraction pattern + one indexing schematic). (a) Bright-field image of an alternating lamellar structure, with red "α" and yellow "κ" labels repeating along the bands; scale bars are 0.5 µm (bottom left) and 500 nm (bottom right). (b) Left: the SADP recorded from the area in (a); right: its schematic index drawn with red α spots labelled (-110)α and (110)α, orange κ spots labelled (200)κ and (1-11)κ, and the printed relations z = [001]α, [001]α//[011]κ, (110)α//(1-11)κ — the Nishiyama–Wasserman relationship. Note the caption calls the pattern a [110] pattern while the printed index gives [001]α, a discrepancy reported below. (c) Dark-field image formed with the (200)κ reflection, κ lamellae bright against dark α; scale bar 200 nm. (d) Bright-field image of globular or short-rod-like κ particles dispersed in the α matrix, with no lamellar arrangement; scale bar 200 nm. The panels together show that 700 °C annealing has decomposed γ into lamellar κ + α with an N–W orientation relationship, while some globular κ retains none.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a TEM bright-field micrograph showing an alternating lamellar structure in which the bands are alternately labelled 'α' (red) and 'κ' (yellow) in a repeating sequence.
Panel (a) carries two scale bars, printed as 0.5 µm (bottom left) and 500 nm (bottom right).

Panel (b) consists of a SADP (diffraction spot pattern) on the left and a matching schematic index on the right; the index prints the α reflections (-110)α and (110)α and the κ reflections (200)κ and (1-11)κ.
Panel (b) prints the zone-axis and plane relations 'z = [001]α', '[001]α//[011]κ' and '(110)α//(1-11)κ', i.e. an orientation relationship between κ-carbide and α matrix.

The caption describes panel (b) as the SADP of (a) 'from [110]', which disagrees with the [001]α zone axis printed inside the panel itself; both readings are reported and neither is confirmed by the other.
Panel (c) is described in the caption as the (200) DF image of (a), and the pixels show bright κ lamellae on a darker α background, consistent with a κ reflection being used to form the image.
Panel (c) carries a 200 nm scale bar; the imaged lamellae are thinner than those in (a), consistent with a higher magnification than (a).
Panel (d) is a TEM bright-field image showing globular and short-rod-like κ particles dispersed in the α matrix, with a 200 nm scale bar; the particles are discrete and not arranged in lamellae.
The caption states the specimen shown was annealed at 700 °C.
The citing text states that the SADP in Fig. 7(b) indicates the Nishiyama–Wasserman (N–W) orientation relationship between κ-carbide and α matrix.

The citing text states that the γ phase has almost totally decomposed to α phase and κ-carbide by the eutectoid reaction γ → α + κ after annealing at 700 °C for 1 h, and that this is what Fig. 7 shows.

The citing text states that not all κ-carbide has an orientation relationship with the α matrix, citing the globular or short-rod-like κ-carbide in Fig. 7(d) as an example with no orientation relationship.

The citing text describes Fig. 7(c) as the (200)_r dark-field image taken from the [100] direction, whereas the caption calls it simply the (200) DF image of (a); the reflection subscript in the citing text is not legible as printed.
No numeric intensity, d-spacing, magnification or composition values are printed on any panel; the only numeric anchors in the panel pixels are the scale-bar lengths.

subfigures.description: TEM bright-field image of the 700 °C specimen showing an alternating lamellar microstructure; red 'α' and yellow 'κ' labels alternate across the bands. Two scale bars are drawn: 0.5 µm (bottom left) and 500 nm (bottom right). The lamellae appear as long, slightly wavy parallel plates with dark contrast fringes.

Selected-area diffraction pattern of the region in (a) (left, grey diffraction spots on dark background with one bright central beam), beside its schematic index (right) drawn with red dots for α reflections labelled (-110)α and (110)α and orange dots for κ reflections labelled (200)κ and (1-11)κ. Printed text: z = [001]α, [001]α//[011]κ, (110)α//(1-11)κ. The caption instead describes this pattern as being from [110].

TEM dark-field image taken with the (200)κ reflection showing bright κ lamellae separated by darker α bands, each annotated with red 'α' and yellow 'κ' labels; scale bar 200 nm (drawn twice, bottom left and bottom right).

TEM bright-field image showing globular and short-rod-like κ particles (labelled 'κ' in yellow) dispersed in a mottled α matrix (labelled 'α' in red); the particles are discrete, rounded or elongated, and not lamellar. Scale bar 200 nm (drawn twice, bottom left and bottom right).

unreadable_items: panel (b) left SADP: individual diffraction spots carry no printed indices; assignments exist only in the adjacent schematic
panel (b): caption zone axis '[110]' cannot be reconciled with the printed 'z = [001]α' in the panel
citing text subscript in '(200)_r' (dark-field reflection) is illegible as printed
